sources.snippet: The aliases fireredtts3-base and fireredtts3-base-bf16 select the same bundle. Only base/mlx-bf16/ and the root model card are downloaded. Additional variants in this repository do not increase the size of a Base download. The same request from the command line

sources.snippet: FireRedTTS3 is a unified speech generation and editing system built on semantically enriched continuous speech representations. It comes in two variants: FireRedTTS3-Base — zero-shot voice cloning across 24 languages and 21 Chinese dialects FireRedTTS3-Instruct — natural-language voice design and speech editing (semantic + acoustic) in one unified model
